scope: Exploratory frozen-checkpoint real-anchor restart diagnostic; not conditional-law certification or a new training run.
design: All eight primary reference groups. First128 R1 parents, one generated continuation per exact intermediate spin state. Same latent batch seeds across trained models. Different groups/start frames use distinct seeds. No future reference spins fed to model.
analysis: Compare short-window nearest-neighbor dot, magnetization moments and increments with the matching observed continuations and autonomous rollout slices. Preserve parent pairing across times and model seeds; keep original family and theta separate. One continuation per intermediate state only supports transition averages over the state ensemble. No per-anchor diversity certification, automatic GO, retraining or seed selection.
